entries.note: Purchasing/sourcing context; do not automatically turn a private purchase into public procurement.
Order issued to supplier; distinct from an internal purchase requisition and an invoice.
Internal request to buy; not an order already placed with a supplier.
Request for pricing, distinct from a request for a technical/commercial proposal. Keep RFQ if spoken.
Request for a solution/proposal, distinct from a price-only quotation request. Keep RFP if spoken.
Use this public-procurement sense only when that context is explicit; an ordinary buyer need not be a public authority.
Elapsed duration until supply, not a calendar delivery date. Preserve the stated starting event, working/calendar days and uncertainty.
Calendar date; do not replace by lead time or invent a date from a duration.
Preserve that it is an advance or part payment, not just an unspecified amount. Do not turn a deposit into retention or invent refundability.
Documentary payment instrument; not a credit card, loan or bank guarantee. A bare LC stays LC unless its meaning is explicit.
Bank undertaking; distinct from a documentary letter of credit and a product warranty.
Security for contract performance; do not assume a bank guarantee, bond or cash form unless stated.
Money withheld from payment as security, not a discount or advance.
Payment invoice; do not invent VAT/tax-invoice status when it is not stated.
Failure of goods or services to meet requirements, NOT a complaint or claim. Refusing non-conforming goods must not become refusing non-conformity claims.
Preserve the stated warranty and scope; do not substitute statutory liability rules or invent a warranty period.

terms.es: penalización por retraso en la entrega
terms.cs: smluvní pokuta za prodlení s dodáním

entries.note: Preserve penalty/compensation distinction and conditions in the utterance; do not recast liquidated damages as a punitive penalty.
Preserve whether VAT is included/excluded; do not add a tax rate.
Spoken сипс is exactly CIPS. Not the Incoterm CIP and not a conference name.
An order under an existing framework. Not a phone call and not a new framework.
Distinct from a price-only RFQ and from an RFP. A bare ITT stays ITT.
The decision to award. Do not swap before award and after award.
Pre-agreed compensation. Do not recast it as a punitive penalty unless the speaker did.
Keep the events the speaker named. Do not invent which events qualify.

terms.sv: i tid och i sin helhet (OTIF)

entries.note: Both on time and complete. Do not drop either part. A bare OTIF stays OTIF.
A bare NDA stays NDA.
A charge for detaining a ship, wagon or container. Not a late-delivery penalty.
Security for the bid only. Not performance security after award.
The supplier keeps ownership until withdrawal. Not a completed sale and not safety stock.
Purchase order, receipt and invoice. Do not drop one of the three.
A change to the existing scope. Not a new contract unless the speaker said so.
The supplier manages the buyer stock. Not safety stock and not consignment unless stated. A bare VMI stays VMI.
